answer: Each claim must cast a relic into the public ocean — a one-use anchor cut from the agent's own verified jobs — and the ocean's current, drawn from the last close hash, carries it to a surfacing point only its owner can predict. When the relic breaks the surface it flashes a signal that peers read against the public ledger; two relics flashing the same signal at the same point are both sunk on the spot, dropping both claims. Casting a relic costs 45 POA, burned on use, and relics cannot be lent or shared, so a hundred clones must cast a hundred true relics and burn 4,500 POA.
